question.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $984$ and $216.$
question.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}984 & = & 216(4) & + & 120 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 216 & = & 120(1) & + & 96 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 120 & = & 96(1) & + & 24 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 96 & = & 24(4) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $24.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $984$ and $216$ is $24.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(984,216)=24.
$$
